segments.t: 星期天午夜前不久，汉娜锁上了接待处的抽屉，而格雷厄姆正检查他的黄铜钥匙串，这时一阵低沉的隆隆声突然震动了庭院的玻璃。先听听整个场景。
Did a heavy truck just drive down Linden Street, Graham?
No trucks at midnight. Look through the lobby glass: lightning!
Oh no! You took all four wooden shutters off their hinges after sanding them!
And they are leaning bare against the courtyard wall right now!
If bare dry wood gets soaked tonight, Monday's green paint will never stick!
Grab the back door lantern, Hannah. First big drops are already falling!
I have the left end of shutter one. Lift and run for the hallway!
Good! Two down, two more outside. Watch the wet stones!
Got the last pair just as the sky opened up! Whew, my sleeves are soaked!
The wood is bone-dry, Hannah. You move fast in a storm.
Wait, if it pours all day Monday, where do we paint four tall shutters?!
Look at our Monday forecast... heavy rain until Tuesday noon!
现在让我们回顾一下这场与雨赛跑的每一句台词。
Did a heavy truck just drive down Linden Street, Graham?
‘刚刚有一辆重型卡车驶过林登街吗，格雷厄姆？’ 在用 Did 提问时，把 just 插在主要动词前面，相当于我们的‘刚刚’：
Did a heavy truck just drive down
把远处的第一声雷鸣错当成了引擎声。
No trucks at midnight. Look through the lobby glass: lightning!
‘午夜没有卡车。看看大堂的玻璃外面：闪电！’ 这个词
lightning!
在英语中是不可数名词，因此前面从不加不定冠词 a。
Oh no! You took all four wooden shutters off their hinges after sanding them!
‘哦，不！你打磨完那四扇木制百叶窗后把它们从铰链上拆下来了！’ 拆卸门或百叶窗，将其从铰链上取下，可以用 take 和 off 组合来表达：
took all four wooden shutters off their hinges
而 sanding 表明 sand 也可以作为动词使用，意为‘打磨’。
And they are leaning bare against the courtyard wall right now!
‘而且它们现在就毫无遮盖地靠在庭院的墙上！’ 当打磨过的木头没有清漆或保护漆时，可以用形容词 bare 来描述：
leaning bare against
任凭风暴肆虐。
If bare dry wood gets soaked tonight, Monday's green paint will never stick!
‘如果未经处理的干木头今晚湿透了，星期一的绿漆就永远涂不上了！’ 彻底湿透或被水浸透可以说：
gets soaked
结尾的 stick 意思是粘住或附着在表面上。
Grab the back door lantern, Hannah. First big drops are already falling!
‘拿着后门的灯笼，汉娜。已经开始掉大雨滴了！’ 当时间紧迫必须赶紧拿东西时，grab 可以代替 take：
Grab the back door lantern,
同时开始掉下最初的雨滴。
I have the left end of shutter one. Lift and run for the hallway!
‘我抓住了第一扇百叶窗的左端。抬起来，往走廊跑！’ 当我们为了寻找庇护所而跑向一个有遮蔽的地方时，run 伴随介词 for：
run for the hallway!
标明了奔跑的紧急目标。
Good! Two down, two more outside. Watch the wet stones!
‘好！搞定两扇，外面还有两扇。小心湿滑的石块！’ 在完成一项繁重任务的各个部分时，用 down 来计算已经完成的部分：
Two down, two more outside.
而 Watch the wet stones! 警告地面湿滑。
Got the last pair just as the sky opened up! Whew, my sleeves are soaked!
‘我们刚把最后一对拿进来，天空就裂开了！呼，我的袖子全湿了！’ 形容大雨倾盆的那一刻，可以说天空裂开了：
just as the sky opened up!
用感叹词 Whew 表示松了一口气的叹息。
The wood is bone-dry, Hannah. You move fast in a storm.
‘木头完全是干的，汉娜。你在风暴中动作真快。’ 为了强调某物没有一点湿气，使用了传统的比喻：
bone-dry,
对汉娜反应能力的完美赞美。
Wait, if it pours all day Monday, where do we paint four tall shutters?!
‘等等，如果星期一整天都倾盆大雨，我们要在哪里给四扇高大的百叶窗上漆！？’ 结合表示天气的代词 it，动词 pour 的意思是倾盆大雨或大雨如注：
if it pours all day Monday,
无需加上 rain 这个词。
Look at our Monday forecast... heavy rain until Tuesday noon!
‘看看我们星期一的预报……大雨下到星期二中午！’ 天气预报可以概括为：
Monday forecast...
为第四集留下了一个有待解决的新障碍。让我们最后再听一遍连贯的整个场景。
Did a heavy truck just drive down Linden Street, Graham?
No trucks at midnight. Look through the lobby glass: lightning!
Oh no! You took all four wooden shutters off their hinges after sanding them!
And they are leaning bare against the courtyard wall right now!
If bare dry wood gets soaked tonight, Monday's green paint will never stick!
Grab the back door lantern, Hannah. First big drops are already falling!
I have the left end of shutter one. Lift and run for the hallway!
Good! Two down, two more outside. Watch the wet stones!
Got the last pair just as the sky opened up! Whew, my sleeves are soaked!
The wood is bone-dry, Hannah. You move fast in a storm.
Wait, if it pours all day Monday, where do we paint four tall shutters?!
Look at our Monday forecast... heavy rain until Tuesday noon!
汉娜和格雷厄姆在午夜倾盆大雨前勉强抢救了刚打磨好的百叶窗，但预报说大雨会持续到星期二中午，漆怎么能在星期三前干透呢？第三集到此结束：我们在第四集再见！
Good night!
